show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A ruthless businesswoman, Sheetal, humiliates her employee Raj, unaware he’s a powerful tycoon in disguise. As ego clashes turn into a toxic marriage, Raj silently endures her cruelty while protecting her and her company from hidden threats. Amid revenge, power games, and emotional turmoil, hatred slowly transforms into love and redemption.
